# Weapons
WH14K boasts a vast arsenal: lasguns, stub guns, bolters, heavy emplacements, sniper rifles, Mechanicus weapons, Tau Pulse, sonic weapons, flamethrowers and grenades.
## Lasguns (energy weapons)
- [color=#a4885c]Lasgun[/color] — the Imperium's workhorse: fires a heat beam, runs off a power cell, needs a two-handed grip and takes a lot of mods. - [color=#a4885c]Accatran[/color] — a fast, compact lasgun: weaker per shot but stitches often, the cell lasts long. - [color=#a4885c]Krieg lasgun[/color] — stronger than the standard one, with a bayonet for trench fighting. A yellow beam that hits hard. - [color=#a4885c]Voss lasgun[/color] — fires without a two-handed grip, more mobile, but fewer mod slots. - [color=#a4885c]Hellgun[/color] — fast and powerful, but feeds from a backpack generator. Without the pack it's useless. - [color=#a4885c]Laspistol[/color] — compact, fires one-handed, good for officers. - [color=#a4885c]Melta gun[/color] — incinerates armor and vehicles, but only point-blank. Useless at range. - [color=#a4885c]Plasma gun[/color] — hits hard and explodes on impact, [color=#ff0000]but sometimes overheats and explodes in your hands, destroying the weapon[/color]. Don't squeeze the trigger for no reason.
## Stub guns (autoguns) - [color=#a4885c]Stub pistol[/color] — compact, hits piercing, fires one-handed. - [color=#a4885c]Heavy stub pistol[/color] — a powerful big-bore, but the magazine is small. - [color=#a4885c]Stub rifle[/color] — universal, with fire modes and plenty of mod slots. Needs a two-handed grip. - [color=#a4885c]Stub SMG[/color] — compact submachine guns with varying fire rate and spread. The third one is a true bullet hose, but no optics. - [color=#a4885c]Stub shotgun[/color] and [color=#a4885c]combat shotgun[/color] — for close quarters, the combat one's drum mag holds more. - [color=#a4885c]Stub MG[/color] — a heavy machine gun with a two-hundred-round belt, needs a two-handed grip.
## Bolters - [color=#a4885c]Bolter rifle[/color] — pierces armor and explodes on impact. A bolter round is damage, a micro-blast and a slowdown all in one. - [color=#a4885c]Bolter pistol[/color] — a compact version, hits just as piercing but the magazine is small. - [color=#a4885c]Astartes bolt pistol[/color] — actually a laser, fires a heat beam, runs off a cell.
## Heavy emplacements (deployable) - [color=#a4885c]Heavy bolter[/color] — a stationary turret: deploy, anchor, and the operator swings the barrel. No anchor, no firing. - [color=#a4885c]Lascannon[/color] — a powerful laser that punches armor and structures. - [color=#a4885c]Multilaser[/color] — a fast laser with a big energy reserve. - [color=#a4885c]Autocannon[/color] — punches armor and explodes, save it for heavy targets.
## Sniper rifles - [color=#a4885c]Londoron Mk2[/color] — one-shots, needs aiming. Prone, aim, fire, reposition. - [color=#a4885c]Londoron Possessed[/color] — a possessed version: hits and pierces, burns and ignites, refills itself over time.
## Mechanicus - [color=#a4885c]Rad carbine[/color] — irradiates the target: damage plus area radiation. Don't stand next to the target after a volley. - [color=#a4885c]Galvanic rifle[/color] — precise weapon with a scope, needs a two-handed grip. - [color=#a4885c]Phosphor weapons[/color] — ignite the target and flood it with heat.
## Tau Pulse Tau weapons hit harder up close and weaker at range — close the distance. - [color=#a4885c]Carbine[/color] — universal, mid range. - [color=#a4885c]Blaster[/color] — fast firing, close range. - [color=#a4885c]Sniper[/color] — long range, for a prepared ambush. - [color=#a4885c]Rail rifle[/color] — punches through everything at long range.
## NoizeMarine sonic weapons Slice flesh with sound and slow the enemy. The Blastmaster is mini-artillery with a shockwave.
## Flamethrower Floods fire and ignites. Ideal for clearing trenches and barricades — but watch the fuel tank.
## Melee - [color=#a4885c]Power fist[/color] — hits heavy and shocks, knocks the enemy back on hit. - [color=#a4885c]Chainsword[/color] — cuts hard, especially two-handed and switched on. - [color=#a4885c]Power saber[/color] — cuts and shocks, reflects some projectiles. - [color=#a4885c]Catachan knife and machete[/color] — light cutting blades for a scout. - [color=#a4885c]Chaos machete[/color] — cuts more than the Catachan one. - [color=#a4885c]Imperium hammer[/color] — smashes and breaks structures, hits twice as hard two-handed, and puts out fire. - [color=#a4885c]Omnissian axe[/color] — a weapon and a multitool in one: cuts, smashes, unscrews, prys, welds.
## Grenades - [color=#a4885c]Frag[/color] — fragmentation, for crowds. - [color=#a4885c]Krak[/color] — anti-tank, a focused blast against armor. - [color=#a4885c]Melta[/color] — anti-tank melta, melts vehicles into a puddle.
## Weapon mods Many guns have slots for modules: optics, suppressor, bipod, sling, bayonet, a long or short barrel. A sniper scope noticeably extends your aiming range, a bipod zeroes spread while prone, a sling keeps the weapon from falling on a stun. More in the separate pages on mods.
## Armor plates The Flak vest takes one plate — laser, bullet or melee. Pick the one that matches the threat on your front. Plates wear out from hits — check them between fights and swap the broken ones.
